display.title: Episode 170: The Rambam's Resting Place, Chapter 2 (Siyum HaRambam)
display.summary_short: In the week of the Rambam's 850th birthday and the first Siyum HaRambam, the story ends as robbers are struck down and a camel leads the Rambam's coffin to Teveria.
display.summary_long: Broadcast in the week of Pesach 5745, when the Rambam's 850th birthday falls on Erev Pesach. Uncle Yossi explains the Rambam's advice to learn his Mishneh Torah right after the Chumash, and the worldwide learning of the whole work over the past year, to be completed with a grand siyum on his birthday. He invites children to a Tzivos Hashem Siyum and Pesach event on Chol HaMoed. After a lively march and a sponsor message, story time recaps how the Rambam's students set out from Egypt with his coffin, unsure where in Eretz Yisroel to bury him. In the desert, armed robbers attack and the caravan scatters. Two brothers lead the Shema. When robbers try to touch the coffin they fall lifeless, and the band flees in fear. Then the camel walks on by itself, as if led by an unseen guide, past every city that hoped for the honor, until it kneels in a field in Teveria, the Rambam's chosen resting place. The show ends with a birthday wish, a greeting for a kosher and happy Pesach, and a call to invite someone without a Seder to join yours.
display.lesson: Hashem, the Guardian of Israel, never sleeps, and He guided the people to the Rambam's resting place; learning the Rambam's works is a way to honor him.

date.note: Rambam's birthday (14 Nissan) is 'this coming Friday' and the first day of Chol HaMoed Pesach is 'this coming Monday' (8 Apr 1985).
